preconditions: New recovery packet has eight exact whole records and root independently accepts it.
A new root GO distinct from original live/continuation GOs is fetched whole.
The old unresolved block still has exact SHA7505abc7; old unknown plan and original errors remain.
The exact armed pending request remains submitted=true, no returned SDK or call record exists for it, and the original operation is completed/inactive with one page at next offset16384.
explicit_historical_block_semantics: The old block object and old plan.phase=unconfirmed are preserved. A separate root-authorized recovery context makes only that exact historical block nonblocking for the existing finite read scope. Any different new block remains blocking. Successful new Git archives restore the historical object; they do not mark the old create successful or reconstruct old tree57bf.
before_Native: After storing the explicit recovery context, archive one new continuation intent whole. Do not call ls/lp or the failed hlState again, and do not set submitted=false. Set a once-only continuation-attempt marker immediately before the one original Native statement.
after_Native: Store original full SDK raw text and hash before reuse of unchanged lc. lc still externalizes original SDK and whole-readbacks before isError/content/JSON parse. Original page and payload checks are byte-identical.
subsequent_scope: Following successful original callback, retain its exact original label and page offset and the new recovery provenance. Any subsequent actions remain the seven fixed-range scope of778d, using reviewed hgRun; no new business or path.
failure_rule: A new Git uncertainty or Native error stops new actions. There is no repeated create, repeated ls/lp, repeated continuation entry, automatic retry, or resetting submitted flags. A context exists before the once call, so reentry is conservatively rejected even if a later preliminary archive fails.
